basics.heading: How the program works
paras: It starts with your medical history and the diets you have tried before, plus a nutritional assessment to check for deficiencies and build a balanced meal plan you can live with.

Based on your history and goals, Dr. Khan may add medication or supplements that curb appetite or support fat burning. These are always paired with a plan to adjust calories and increase activity, never used alone.
Progress is tracked at follow-up visits and the plan changes as you do. For stubborn areas, body contouring can complement the program.

Can I combine weight loss with body contouring?
Yes. Many patients add SmartLipo, CoolSculpting or Kybella for areas that do not respond to diet and exercise.
